command.description: The Expo CLI command: start, export, run:ios, run:android, prebuild. Or macos or linux, which build the desktop host and open the app in it, and package, which packages the desktop app: all run ng-native-desktop from @ng-native/desktop.

args.description: Arguments passed to the command as they are.

platform.description: Passed as --platform, for export. Not for macos, linux or package.

port.description: Passed as --port: the port Metro listens on, or for macos and linux the one the host loads the app from. Not for package, which has no dev server.

clear.description: Passed as --clear: start Metro with an empty transform cache. Not for macos, linux or package.
